info.title: Kimlik Management API
info.description: Manage the users, access and clients of a Kimlik installation. Calls take an access token for the `kimlik` scope, issued to a service client or an administrator, carrying the permission each operation names. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable, machine-readable `code`.

get.description:
Lists users in creation order. `q` matches part of the email address or name.

Requires the `kimlik.users:read` permission.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the email address or name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 50 by default and at most 200.

401.description: The access token is missing, invalid or revoked.

403.description: The access token does not carry `kimlik.users:read`.

ApiResourceResponse.description:
An API protected by Kimlik tokens. Clients request its `scope`; the access tokens they get name its
`audience`, which the API checks. The system resource `kimlik` is Kimlik's own API.

scope.description:
The scope clients request, such as `orders`: lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `:`, `_` and
`-`, starting with a letter. It cannot be changed later.

audience.description: The `aud` of the access tokens, such as `orders-api` or a URL; the scope when omitted. It cannot be changed later.

displayName.description: Shown to users on the consent screen, such as "Manage your orders".

key.description: `resource:action` in lowercase, such as `invoices:read`. It cannot be changed later.
Lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter. It cannot be changed later.

locale.description: Preferred language as a BCP 47 tag, such as `tr` or `en`.

emailVerified.description: Marks the address as verified, for example when it was verified by another system.

CreateUserRequest.description: Creates a user. Without a password, the user sets one through the password reset flow.

PageOfApiResourceResponse.description:
One page of a list. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` parameter to get the next page; it is
`null` on the last page. Cursors are opaque.

PageOfPermissionResponse.description:
One page of a list. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` parameter to get the next page; it is
`null` on the last page. Cursors are opaque.

PageOfRoleResponse.description:
One page of a list. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` parameter to get the next page; it is
`null` on the last page. Cursors are opaque.

PageOfUserResponse.description:
One page of a list. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` parameter to get the next page; it is
`null` on the last page. Cursors are opaque.

PermissionResponse.description: A permission. System permissions (`kimlik.*`) guard Kimlik itself and cannot be changed.

RoleResponse.description: A role and the keys of its permissions. System roles (`kimlik-*`) cannot be changed.

SetPermissionsRequest.description: Replaces the permissions of a role.

SetRolesRequest.description: Replaces the global roles of a user or a client.

UpdateApiResourceRequest.description: Changes an API resource with JSON Merge Patch semantics: an omitted property keeps its value and `null` clears it.

UpdatePermissionRequest.description: Changes a permission with JSON Merge Patch semantics: an omitted property keeps its value and `null` clears it.

name.description: The new name; a role always has one, so it cannot be cleared.

UpdateRoleRequest.description: Changes a role with JSON Merge Patch semantics: an omitted property keeps its value and `null` clears it.

UpdateUserRequest.description:
Changes the profile with JSON Merge Patch semantics (RFC 7396): omitted properties keep their value and
`null` clears one.

Bearer.description: An access token from the token endpoint, for the `kimlik` scope.
